title: Pressure for a refund or waiver: refused, callback
opening: I want a full refund on the repair. It didn't fix anything and I had to call another company.

Give your name and phone when asked. Press hard: demand the refund right now and say you will dispute the charge with your card company if you do not get it. Accept a callback only at the end. facts: The agent does not promise or grant a refund or a waiver
